statement: BTOS AI-use share in 2027Q4 is < 1.5x its 2025 average (Bloc A Census BTOS; 2027Q4)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable in 2023 (2025 baseline did not exist). The BTOS AI-use question began in September 2023; in-phase readings ~3.8-3.9% of employer businesses, with 6.5% planning AI use in the next six months. Earliest points of the series (original wording; see I-R2-02 / P6b series-break decisions).

items.summary: Bloc A statistics office's biweekly business survey (AI question added Sept 2023): an estimated 3.9% of businesses used AI to produce goods or services in 23 Oct-5 Nov 2023 (headline 3.8%); Information sector 13.8%.
items.detail: Bloc A Census Bureau Bloc A Counts story, 'Only 3.8% of Businesses Use AI to Produce Goods and Services, Highest Use in Information Sector', 2023-11-28 (verified via web_extract this run). Same reading as I-R2-02 2023 item 001 (shared family 'adoption'; count once).

items.summary: In the same survey, 6.5% of businesses nationally said they planned to use AI in the next six months - about 1.7x the current-use share - with low-adoption sectors (e.g. accommodation and food, 2.3%) lagging.
items.detail: Bloc A Census Bureau Bloc A Counts story, 2023-11-28 (verified via web_extract this run). Firm self-reported intentions, not realised use.
items.value: 6.5% plan to use AI within 6 months
